macros.name: clipbox
macros.doc: The \clipbox macro works like the \trimbox and trims the given amounts from the 〈text〉. However, in addition the trimmed material is also clipped, i.e. it is not shown in the final document.

macros.name: clipbox*
macros.doc: The \clipbox macro works like the \trimbox and trims the given amounts from the 〈text〉. However, in addition the trimmed material is also clipped, i.e. it is not shown in the final document.

macros.name: trimbox
macros.doc: The macro \trimbox trims the given amount from the lower left (ll) and the upper right (ur) corner of the box.

macros.name: trimbox*
macros.doc: The macro \trimbox trims the given amount from the lower left (ll) and the upper right (ur) corner of the box.
